chunks: God originates creation, and then will revert it, then you will go back to Him.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's role in creating and returning humanity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ar-Rum underscores the continuity between creation (khalq) and resurrection (i'ad), affirming God's absolute sovereignty over the cosmic cycle. It serves as a theological anchor for the concept of return (ma'ad), reminding believers that all existence originates from and ultimately converges back to the Divine Will.
